scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with Bloom levels. Each one has at least 3 questions with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, q2, q5; o2: q3, q6, q7; o3: q4, q9, q8), and the exam has apply and evaluate transfer items: q5 on `config/production.yml` and q8 on a Web-page-summarizing MCP server.

hook-problem sets out a concrete failure in 2 sentences (「CLAUDE.mdに「`.env` は編集しないこと」と書いたのに、Claudeが `.env` を書き換えようとしました。」) and adds a version line. hook-predict is ungraded, and option d (Manual) is a real near-miss. The q0 explanation now names 「第2回の拒否ルールのように」 as another mechanism.

The prerequisites list lessons 2, 6 and 7, jq and JSON editing, and s2-setup starts with `jq --version`. Earlier lessons are recalled in s1-lead (「第6回のとおり」「第2回の権限ルールやフック」) and s5-lead (「第7回のスキルやサブエージェントは」). The definitions blocks match the glossary word for word. One gap: `onFailure` appears in s3-pitfall without a gloss.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 1852 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2838 · practice reading 1092 · questions 10 · practice sections 1 · est 17.4 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, and estMinutes 17 matches; lint shows 0 warnings and every segment has at most 3 terms. The load is still uneven: the practice section holds two tasks in 11 blocks, the q9 stem is one paragraph of about 190 characters, and s3 says 「exit 0 は許可ではない」 twice (s3-table and s3-zero).

s2 is a complete worked example with subgoal titles, and each step gives its reason: ex-script says 「`exit 2` は「止める」の合図で…」, ex-register explains `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, ex-test says 「JSONの中の `rm` は文字として渡るだけ」. Every step has an observable expect. The practice then fades it (「例題と違うのは、マッチャーと取り出す項目です」), and q5 transfers it.

There are inline checks in s1, s2, s3, s5 and the practice. q1 is an apply item, q2 an analyze item (`cd docs && rm notes.txt` against `rmdir old`), and q9 an evaluate item with crossed A×B options. Every wrong option has feedback. One soft spot: q3's answer b (「「hook error」の通知が出て編集が進む」) repeats the s3-table cell almost word for word.

All 6 misconceptions in the brief are corrected with a reason. CLAUDE.md as a guarantee: q0 a/b, q1 a, q7 b. exit 1 blocks: q3 a/c, q5 b. exit 0 approves: s3-zero 「止めないだけで、許可ではありません」 and q3 d. PostToolUse undoes the edit: q6 b. The condition catches everything: q2 a/b/d and the practice-prompt note. Official means safe: q4 d, q8 b. Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer, and q8 d now names the origin and the author.

s1-lifecycle is a 6-node process diagram with Japanese labels that match the text. The edge 「通す（権限の確認へ）」 agrees with s3-table. The caption states the takeaway, and the alt text describes both paths. All tables have 2 columns, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and faded. Each step has an expect, the hints build up (step hint → troubleshoot → model answer), there are model answers for both halves and a 5-item self-check, and the p-predict hint now says 「渡す先は `.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` にします」. The new p-script troubleshoot is misleading, though: it says to check `chmod +x` when the hook does not appear in `/hooks`, and it leaves out the restart that 「例題の②と同じく」 points to (see mustFix).

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection question (「あなたのCLAUDE.mdで、本当は毎回必ず守らせたいルールはどれでしょう？」), the next lesson and a descriptive link. There are 7 flashcards, and card-before-install now lists the same six labels as s5-checks.

All 5 audit findings are fixed in the text. s3-pitfall now says 「ふつう止まらず」 and names `onFailure`. q3 says 「`onFailure` は設定していません」. q6's prompt mentions stderr, and its d feedback now says 「`PostToolUse` の `exit 2` で」. s1-config reads 「処理（ここではコマンド）」, and the p-script expect no longer says the matcher appears. s5-risk now reads 「あなたのPCのユーザー権限」, the version is pinned to v2.1.304, and the brief records re-running every script. The troubleshoot imprecision is listed under practice.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, the tone is warm (「結果を先に予想しましょう」) and there are no banned phrases. Terms stay consistent: the six s5-checks labels are reused in practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b and card-before-install, and 「権限の確認」 is used everywhere. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The only locale (jp) is complete, the diagram labels are in Japanese, the alt text covers both paths, and the link text is descriptive (「フックの公式ガイド（日本語）」). Plain-text fields (checklist labels, captions, prompt) carry no markdown, for example 「cat .envで」 and 「.envの末尾に」.

mustFix.issue: The new p-script troubleshoot (「`/hooks` に出ないときは、例題の②と同じく、JSONのカンマと `chmod +x` を確かめます。」) mixes up two failures. `/hooks` is a read-only list of configured hooks (audit quote from hooks.md), so a missing `chmod +x` makes the hook fail to start; it does not hide it from the list. ex-register, which this troubleshoot points to, says exactly this (「許可がないとフックは起動せず、何も止まりません。一覧に出ないときは、JSONの余計なカンマなどを直し、Claude Codeを再起動します。」). A learner whose hook is missing because the settings were not reloaded checks commas and chmod, finds both fine, and is not told to restart.
mustFix.fix: Set p-script troubleshoot to: "`/hooks` に出ないときは、例題の②と同じく、JSONの余計なカンマなどを直し、Claude Codeを再起動します。手で試して `Permission denied` と出たら、`chmod +x` を実行します。"

niceToHave: s3-check q3: answer b (「フックでは止まらず、「hook error」の通知が出て編集が進む」) repeats the s3-table cell 「止めないエラー。ふつうは進み、「hook error」の通知が出る」, so a learner can pick it by the phrase 「hook error」. Set option b md to "フックでは止まらず、ふだんの権限の確認へ進む". Then the learner must know what exit 1 does, and b still contrasts with d (「確認なしで編集が許可される」).

s4 (`claude mcp add`, scopes) is covered by no objective and no question, yet summary-points[2] and card-scopes are about it. Either tie it to o3 (for example a q8 distractor about committing to `.mcp.json` at `project` scope instead of trying it at `local` scope first) or cut summary point 3 to "MCPサーバーも、入れる前に確かめてからスコープを選んで追加します。".

s3-zero repeats the s3-table cell 「（許可ではない）」. Make the table cell "進む。表示はなく、ふだんの権限の確認へ", and let s3-zero carry the correction plus its consequence: "`exit 0` は止めないだけで、許可ではありません。Manualモードなら、ふだんどおり確認が出ます。`exit 2` は、どの権限モードでも操作を止めます。"
s3-pitfall: `onFailure` appears without a gloss. Use "…`onFailure`（失敗したときの扱いを決める設定）を `\"block\"` にしたフックなどでは、失敗でも止まります。"

practice-steps p-predict hint: the example JSON keeps `"tool_name":"Bash"` while it carries a `file_path`. The script ignores the tool name, but a test that looks like an edit is clearer: "例題のテストのコマンドを使います。`tool_name` を `\"Edit\"` に、`tool_input` を `{\"file_path\":\".env\"}` に変えます。渡す先は `.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` にします。"

check-quiz q8: q4 taught that what runs (実行内容) is the first thing to check, but q8's explanation names only the origin, the author and the permission rules. Add to the explanation: "`.mcp.json` に書かれる起動コマンドやURLも、入れる前に読みます。"

practice-b-quiz q9: the stem is one paragraph of about 190 characters, over the 160 paragraph budget, which lint does not check in stems. Move the two candidate descriptions into practice-b-task (one sentence group for A, one for B) and keep the stem as "架空の2候補について、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？".

The practice section holds two separate tasks (build the .env hook, then evaluate two candidates) in 11 blocks. Splitting the evaluation into its own practice section would ease the load. This is a structural change and would need a full review.
summary: Full review: review-scope.mjs exited 1 (25 of 49 blocks changed, 51%, over 30%). The previous must-fix is fixed: the p-predict hint now pipes the JSON to protect-files.sh. All 5 audit findings and most earlier suggestions are applied (`onFailure` exception, 「処理（ここではコマンド）」, 「あなたのPCのユーザー権限」, the deny-rule mention in q0 and s1-lead), and the worked example → faded practice → transfer exam chain is strong. One fix remains: the new p-script troubleshoot says to check `chmod +x` when a hook is missing from `/hooks` and leaves out the restart. It should match ex-register.
